title: Unify bounded commit subjects and exact canonical Task-ID validation

owned: one deterministic bounded-commit-subject-prefix helper shared by CI, the worker commit wrapper, and canonical done
cross-check between a commit subject's prefix and its Task-ID trailer in CI
duplicate/conflicting Task-ID (and other required) trailer rejection in CI
worker_commit.py preflight validation of subject identity and Task-ID trailer before staging/committing
removal of ai_status.py's second, looser trailer parser (parse_commit_metadata_lines) in favor of the shared one
not_changing: validate_merged_tooling_done's Human/Ops + development_tooling authority, its reviewer-free direct-tooling exception, and its full-message regex/ancestry behavior
approved_closeout_commit_ref / approved_closeout_metadata_ref merge-first-parent unwrapping and ancestry verification
scripts/git/check_commit_scope.py (a separate pre-commit hook script, not in this task's artifacts)
auto_integrator.py, worker_runner.py, supervisor.py, branch protection, credentials, or canonical JSON shape
short task-id behavior: a subject containing the literal id (including as a substring, e.g. inside a merge commit's task/<id> branch name) still passes exactly as before
composes_with: the existing per-task PR review/merge flow used to recover PR #5639's own original approval

failure_reproduction.case: On dev 46bbfe935df1e68740569fb5dc6233897de98b0b, check_commit_trailers.check_message required subjects <=72 chars while ai_status.py's done-finalize gate required the literal, untruncated task id to appear in the subject. A 92-char generated task id (INTEGRATION-UNBLOCK-GOV-APPROVAL-AUTHORITY-PREREQUISITE-001-MERGE-STATE-BLOCKED-B14932FE23E9) cannot satisfy both: its genuine, independently-approved, merged (PR #5639, head 50adbe0c68cfcc5d42024061c91f86dedb45159c into c607359338026f4e440f62d052e19648d78d3f04) commit passed CI's bounded-subject check but could never satisfy done's literal-substring check.
failure_reproduction.regression_short_id: scripts/test_ai_status.py::DeliveryMetadataValidationTests::test_collect_done_delivery_metadata_skips_trailers_for_merge_commit (pre-existing, unmodified) proves the short-id literal-substring path is unchanged.
failure_reproduction.regression_long_id_accept: scripts/test_ai_status.py::DeliveryMetadataValidationTests::test_collect_done_delivery_metadata_accepts_bounded_prefix_for_long_task_id reproduces the real 92-char id and its deterministic bounded prefix (via the same canonical_commit_subject_prefix CI now also uses) and proves done's finalize gate now accepts it.
failure_reproduction.regression_long_id_reject: scripts/test_ai_status.py::DeliveryMetadataValidationTests::test_collect_done_delivery_metadata_rejects_bounded_prefix_for_wrong_task proves a subject naming an unrelated task is still rejected.
failure_reproduction.regression_ci_bounded_prefix: scripts/git/test_check_commit_trailers_independent_review.py::test_accepts_bounded_subject_prefix_for_a_generated_long_task_id proves CI accepts the same convention.
failure_reproduction.regression_ci_wrong_prefix: scripts/git/test_check_commit_trailers_independent_review.py::test_rejects_subject_prefix_naming_a_different_task (new) -- CI previously had no cross-check between the subject prefix and the Task-ID trailer at all.
failure_reproduction.regression_ci_duplicate_trailer: scripts/git/test_check_commit_trailers_independent_review.py::test_rejects_conflicting_task_id_trailers (new) -- parse_trailers is last-write-wins and previously let a duplicated/forged Task-ID line through silently.
failure_reproduction.regression_worker_commit: scripts/git/test_worker_commit.py::test_worker_commit_accepts_bounded_prefix_for_long_task_id / rejects_subject_naming_a_different_task / rejects_missing_task_id_trailer / rejects_wrong_task_id_trailer / rejects_conflicting_task_id_trailers (new) -- worker_commit.py previously only checked subject length, with no identity cross-check at all.

implementation.shared_helper: common.canonical_commit_subject_prefix(task_id, max_len=72) in .orchestrator/common.py is the single deterministic bounded-subject-prefix function; bound_commit_subject now derives its own prefix/compaction from the same two extracted helpers (_normalized_task_prefix, _compacted_task_prefix) so it cannot diverge from the validator's answer.
implementation.ci_check_commit_trailers: check_message now cross-checks the subject prefix against canonical_commit_subject_prefix(<Task-ID trailer>) when prefix_required is true and a Task-ID trailer is present, and rejects any required trailer that appears more than once with conflicting values (duplicate_trailer_problems).
implementation.worker_commit_preflight: worker_commit.py's preflight now accepts a subject containing either the literal --task-id or its canonical_commit_subject_prefix, and separately requires exactly one Task-ID trailer in the body equal to --task-id.
implementation.ai_status_done_gate: collect_done_delivery_metadata's subject check now accepts task_id in subject OR canonical_commit_subject_prefix(task_id) in subject (previously only the literal substring, which a long id's necessarily-compacted subject can never satisfy). The unrelated Task-ID trailer-value check (parsed via the newly-shared check_commit_trailers.parse_trailers, replacing the removed duplicate parse_commit_metadata_lines) is unchanged.
implementation.validate_merged_tooling_done_unchanged: Confirmed unchanged: still a full-message regex against the exact caller-supplied, ancestry-verified commit, with the existing word-boundary guard against substring false-positives (test_validate_merged_tooling_done_rejects_task_id_substring, unmodified, still passes).

recovery_note: This task fixes the identity contract going forward only. Recovering the original PR #5639 delivery uses the existing resume_integration / owner done flow against its own real approval and merge record; this task does not mark PR #5639 done or fabricate a new approval for it.

review_decision.note: Independently verify: the single shared canonical_commit_subject_prefix helper (no divergent duplicate logic remains in bound_commit_subject), the CI subject-vs-trailer cross-check and duplicate-trailer rejection, worker_commit.py's new preflight identity checks, the done-finalize gate accepting the real long-id bounded prefix while still rejecting a wrong-task subject and preserving the unmodified short-id/merge-commit/validate_merged_tooling_done paths, and the full combined test run.
